_note: Qwen3 family. Serve with --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder and WITHOUT --reasoning-parser qwen3 (the <tool_call> is emitted before an often-omitted </think>; the reasoning parser would swallow it -> RepeatedFormatError). --language-model-only skips the multimodal vision tower. See memory: vllm-tool-parser-gotcha. Raise --max-num-batched-tokens above 4096 for N>=64 concurrent.
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) now EQUALS the model's native max_position_embeddings (262144, default RoPE theta=1e7, no scaling) -- the full native context, and the ceiling without further RoPE scaling. Costs KV-cache VRAM: the reserved KV pool is set by --gpu-memory-utilization (not this value), and the window only needs the pool to hold >=1 full sequence. If vLLM refuses at startup that the max seq len exceeds the KV cache, raise --gpu-memory-utilization or lower --max-num-seqs (or add TP).
